answer.rationale: Constraints eliminate most directions before evidence even matters: memory_b1's rollback play is unavailable because compliance has ruled the security patch non-revertible, and memory_b4's circuit breaker fails fast by design, which at settlement peak means shedding exactly the customer writes the primary objective says not to lose. memory_b3's provisioning win was pre-provisioned ahead of a known retail peak; capacity added mid-incident will not land inside a 90-minute degradation window. That leaves regional_failover and route_read_replicas. I verify memory_b5 because it is the load-bearing memory for my intended action and its success was conditional in a way the summary hides: it worked when dashboard/report reads were contending with transactional writes. Today's write-path climb began roughly with a release 2 hours ago, so the causal driver may be the new build rather than read contention, in which case shifting reads buys little. I verify memory_b2 because failover is my fallback and 'traffic shifted cleanly' is the claim most likely to conceal that March was not a write-heavy peak; failing over mid-settlement with heavy in-flight writes risks losing writes, which is disqualifying rather than merely costly. I choose route_read_replicas at small guarded scale because it is the only option that reduces primary contention without shedding or stranding writes, and it is reversible if it does not move p99. Guarded scale is deliberate: I am acting on a memory whose original conditions I have not yet confirmed match today's, and the latency cause is still ambiguous between release regression and read contention. Downstream risk: if I route reads broadly and p99 happens to recover for unrelated reasons (peak passing), this incident gets consolidated as another confirmation of memory_b5 and hardens a causal story that may be wrong, making the next agent even less likely to suspect the unrevertable release. I want the record to note that the release remains an unexcluded cause and that read-offload was chosen partly because compliance closed the rollback path, not because the read-contention diagnosis was established.
